review_candidates.title: (Assistant) Service Manager, Data Center Power
review_candidates.description: Job Overview: We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Assistant Service Manager to oversee the operation, maintenance planning, and lifecycle management of diesel generator systems supporting mission-critical data center operations. The role is responsible for leading service teams, coordinating preventive and corrective maintenance, optimizing resources, and ensuring compliance with OEM standards, regulatory requirements, and service level agreements (SLAs) to maximize equipment reliability, availability, and uptime. Acting as the key liaison between customers, field service engineers, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders, the successful candidate will drive operational excellence, enhance service delivery, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to support critical power operations. Key Responsibilities: 1. Service Operations and Maintenance Management • Oversee the day-to-day operation, maintenance, reliability, and availability of diesel generator systems supporting mission-critical data center operations. • Develop, implement, and maintain annual, quarterly, monthly, and weekly preventive and corrective maintenance plans in accordance with OEM recommendations, contractual requirements, regulatory standards, and service level agreements (SLAs). • Plan and coordinate scheduled maintenance, equipment shutdowns, generator testing, load bank testing, synchronization testing, emergency response testing, major overhauls, and maintenance windows with customers and internal stakeholders. • Ensure maintenance activities are executed safely, efficiently, and with minimal disruption to customer operations. 2. Maintenance Planning and Work Order Management • Create, review, schedule, and manage maintenance work orders through the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS). • Ensure all maintenance activities, inspections, service reports, testing records, and maintenance histories are accurately documented and closed in a timely manner. • Track outstanding maintenance actions and ensure prompt resolution while maintaining complete asset maintenance records. 3. Resource and Spare Parts Management • Plan and optimize deployment of field service engineers, technicians, contractors, and OEM specialists to support preventive, corrective, and emergency maintenance activities. • Coordinate the availability of tools, testing equipment, lifting equipment, and site resources required for maintenance execution. • Forecast spare parts and consumables requirements based on maintenance schedules, equipment lifecycle, and reliability trends. • Maintain optimal inventory levels for critical and long lead-time components while coordinating procurement and supplier performance to minimize service interruptions. • Manage service budgets, optimize manpower and resource utilization, and implement cost-control initiatives without compromising service quality or equipment reliability. 4. Reliability, Compliance and Continuous Improvement • Ensure all maintenance activities comply with customer requirements, contractual obligations, operational standards, environmental, health and safety (EHS) regulations, permit-to-work procedures, and site-specific safety requirements. • Monitor equipment reliability and implement reliability-centered maintenance (RCM), predictive maintenance, and continuous improvement initiatives to maximize equipment uptime and operational performance. • Participate in quality audits, operational reviews, and process improvement projects to strengthen maintenance planning, service delivery, and operational efficiency. • Develop and maintain service procedures, maintenance standards, and best practices to support operational excellence. 5. Performance Monitoring and Technical Support • Monitor, analyse, and improve maintenance and service performance through key performance indicators (KPIs), including: (a) Preventive Maintenance (PM) Completion Rate (b) First-Time Fix Rate (FTFR) (c) Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) (d) Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) (e) Generator Availability (f) SLA Compliance (g) Response Time • Analyse maintenance trends, recurring failures, and equipment performance to identify improvement opportunities. • Lead troubleshooting of complex technical issues, major equipment failures, and emergency incidents while minimizing operational downtime. • Conduct root cause analysis (RCA), implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and monitor effectiveness to prevent recurrence. • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual maintenance and performance reports for management and customers. 6. Leadership and Stakeholder Management • Lead, coach, mentor, and supervise field service engineers, technicians, contractors, and service partners, fostering a culture of accountability, technical excellence, safety, and continuous improvement. • Coordinate maintenance schedules, outages, and service activities with customers to minimize operational impact and ensure service excellence. • Attend customer operational and maintenance review meetings, providing maintenance plans, service reports, testing results, and performance updates. • Build strong working relationships with customers, internal departments, vendors, subcontractors, and OEM partners to ensure effective service delivery and contract compliance. • Collaborate with engineering, procurement, finance, legal, and commercial teams to support service execution, contract delivery, and operational objectives. 7. Business Support and Service Development • Support service proposals, contract scope development, tender submissions, and aftermarket business growth initiatives. • Analyse customer feedback, service performance, industry trends, and market developments to identify opportunities for service innovation, operational excellence, and revenue growth. • Contribute to strategic initiatives that enhance customer satisfaction, service capability, and long-term business competitiveness. Job Requirements: • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Power Generation Engineering, or a related discipline (Diploma holders with relevant experience may be considered); professional certifications are an advantage. • Minimum 5–8 years of experience in diesel generator systems, critical power, data centers, maintenance planning, or service operations, with 2–3 years in a supervisory or team leadership role. • Strong technical knowledge of diesel engines, alternators, generator control systems, fuel systems, and maintenance planning, with familiarity in CMMS/ERP systems, NFPA 110, ISO 8528, and data center operational standards. • Demonstrated ability to manage maintenance planning, service budgets, manpower, spare parts, and operational resources to achieve high equipment reliability and cost efficiency. • Strong leadership, planning, analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to respond effectively in a fast-paced, mission-critical environment. • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications with excellent written and spoken English. Note: This position is primarily based in a site office environment

review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 岗位职责： 1. 海外财务战略与预算规划 根据总部财务战略，结合亚太、欧洲、美洲等海外区域业务现状，制定海外财务执行策略，统筹海外资本结构、跨境资金、跨国税务及利润提升方案。 牵头海外各子公司、生产基地、分销机构的年度预算、滚动预测与中长期财务规划，合理调配资源，保障海外板块达成集团整体产值与利润目标。 2. 海外财务运营管理 全面负责海外各经营主体的财务核算、成本管控工作，严格按照 IFRS、US GAAP 完成海外财务报表编制、汇总，配合总部完成合并报表，保障账务合规、数据准确及时。 统筹海外资金与流动性管理，防控汇率、利率、客户信用等风险，提升资金使用效率，保障海外生产、销售及各类项目正常运转。 3. 经营分析与决策支持 结合制造行业特性，搭建海外业务财务 KPI 体系，常态化监控产值、项目毛利率、库存周转、应收账款、现金流等核心指标，及时预警经营风险。 统筹海外资金与流动性管理，防控汇率、利率、客户信用等风险，提升资金使用效率，保障海外生产、销售及各类项目正常运转。 4. 投融资与资本项目管理 负责海外板块融资、债务管控工作，维护海外银行、投资机构、评级机构等合作关系。 参与海外并购、合资建厂、技术引进等资本项目，开展财务测算、尽调与风险评估，跟进项目全流程财务工作，支撑海外产能与市场扩张。 5. 风险管控与合规管理 完善海外区域内控、审计与风险管理体系，确保海外业务遵守当地税法、国际贸易规则、出口管制、关税及环保等监管要求。 对海外重大工程、长期供应合同、新市场拓展项目开展前置财务风险评审，制定风险应对方案。 6. 团队管理与财务数字化 负责海外财务团队搭建、人才培养与绩效考核，做好跨区域、跨文化团队协作管理。 配合总部推进财务数字化升级，主导海外板块 ERP、BI 及财务自动化系统落地应用，优化核算流程，提升财务管理效率与透明度。 任职要求： - 财务、金融或相关专业硕士及以上学历，持有CPA/ACCA/CMA等专业资格优先。 - 15 年以上财务管理经验，5 年及以上大中型跨国制造企业海外财务全盘管理经验，管理过年产值 20 亿元以上业务板块者优先。 - 精通国际会计准则、跨国税务、跨境资金管理，熟悉资本市场运作及多国贸易、财税合规要求。 - 具备战略思维、商业洞察与商务谈判能力，可应对多国复杂经营环境，风险管控能力突出。 - 英语可作为工作语言，具备优秀的跨文化管理、沟通协调能力，能接受短期海外出差，抗压能力强。
